title: Recognition Rate for Laboratory Payments: Uninsured Households and Frequent Testing, Patient Financial Assistance Program
content:
**Rate schedule.** The recognition rate is the percent of the payments counted that the laboratory-payments deduction on a Patient Financial Assistance Program case recognizes. It depends on the household's coverage and its testing: a household with no active coverage on file and at least 6 test charges posted on its orders in the last twelve whole months uses the full rate of 100 percent; a household with no active coverage on file and fewer such test charges uses the partial rate of 75 percent; for any other household this rate schedule does not change the recognition rate.

| Active coverage on file in Insurance Coverage & Claims | Test charges posted on the household's Laboratory Test Orders in the last twelve whole months | Recognition rate under this schedule |
|---|---|---|
| None | 6 or more | 100 percent |
| None | 5 or fewer | 75 percent |
| At least one | Any number | Not changed |

**Counting the test charges.** Every test charge posted on the household's Laboratory Test Orders counts once, where the posting is dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today. Active coverage means a coverage in active status; a coverage pending verification, inactive or terminated is not active.

## Boundary and worked cases (hypothetical households, payments counted $1100.00)

- No active coverage, exactly 6 test charges in the window: 100 percent, recognizing $1100.00 of the payments counted.
- No active coverage, 5 test charges: 75 percent, recognizing $825.00 of the payments counted.
- An active coverage on file, 9 test charges: this schedule does not change the rate.
